applies_to: CITY MULTI indoor units, Lossnay/OA units and heat-pump boilers connected to one G-50 central controller (up to 50 units).
summary: The Procon BAC-IP/50 is a small Mitsubishi Electric UK gateway that connects to a G-50 controller over Ethernet and serves up to 50 units as BACnet IP objects. Each unit address gets the same block of setup (_w) and state (_r) objects, named after the unit name typed into the configuration program. It does not support segmentation and its APDU limit is small, so keep read-multiple requests short.
notes: Per-unit instance = 1UUUPP: UUU = unit address 001-050, PP = point. Instances here use unit 001 (e.g. 100101). Object names start with the configured unit name (nnn).
OC/BC Error Code uses 1YYY22 where YYY = unit address 051-100; 105122 shown for address 051.
Points 1xxx19-1xxx21 are listed as unused and are not included.
Only the group's master unit accepts commands; writes to slave addresses have no effect.
AutoHeat/AutoCool are reported only when DIP switch A-1 (Auto-Detail) is on; heating/hot-water modes apply to heat-pump boilers only.
Device instance, device name and object names are set only through the PC configuration program; a level-2 reset restores Device ID 10.

points.name: nnn_ECode
points.description: Unit error code, 4 digits (8000 = no error)

points.name: Device
points.description: Gateway device object (factory default 10, user settable)

integration.summary: Give the BAC-IP/50 and its G-50 separate IP addresses on the same subnet, set the device ID and unit names with the PC configuration program, then map the per-unit _w (command) and _r (status) objects. Only the master unit of each group accepts commands.
integration.enable: The Enable Link terminals take a normally-closed volt-free contact (shipped with a wire link). Opening it sets the G-50 Forced-Off (all units off, remotes disabled) and resends every 5 s; closing it sends one Reset so later BMS Forced-Off commands are not overridden. Local remotes can be inhibited per unit with nnn_LI_w.
integration.heartbeat: No BMS heartbeat. Sys_G50_Comms_State goes inactive when the G-50 is off or unreachable, and Sys_Mnet_State is inactive while M-Net initialises, when the units are effectively offline.
setup: Level-2 reset defaults: IP 192.168.1.10, gateway 192.168.1.10, mask 255.255.255.0, G-50 IP 192.168.1.1, Device ID 10, name 'Procon BAC-IP/50', foreign device registration TTL 1800 s.
10BASE-T half duplex only, no auto-negotiation; configuration and firmware updates go through the RS232/RS485 configuration port.
Device ID, device name and object names can only be set with the PC configuration program.
DIP switch A-1 (Auto-Detail) reports AutoHeat/AutoCool; A-2 (Preserve-Settings) keeps Present_Value and Priority_Array through power-up.
gotchas: Writes to slave units in a group have no effect; command the master address.
Set Sys_New_Setting_Compare active if the BMS rewrites commands continuously, so only changed values go to the G-50.
No segmentation and a 206-octet maximum APDU, so keep ReadPropertyMultiple requests small.
